public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and other AI developers should disclose how their systems are trained and updated, and should let users mark test examples to exclude them from training; not doing so is irresponsible.

statement.excerpt: And finally, for the executives and chief scientists of OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and other companies engaged in building these things: DO provide detailed information about how your systems have been trained and updated., and DO provide a method whereby a user can mark a test example or benchmark so that it is not used in training and thus made useless for testing. To fail to do that is both socially and scientifically irresponsible.
